title: Task Manager font size doesn't update immediately when system font size changes
line: Task Manager labels and other Plasma text now switch to the new size as soon as the system font size is changed.
explanation: Plasma's panels and popups are plain Qt Quick windows, which never push a changed application font to items that already exist, so every Label kept the font it was created with and only newly created ones (like a new task) got the new size. Plasma's Kirigami theme also set its default and small fonts once at creation and never refreshed them. The Kirigami Plasma style plugin now tells every theme it created when the application font changes, the theme recomputes both fonts in one place used at creation too, and Plasma's Label binds its font to the theme's default font, as the desktop style's Label already does.

commits.message:
plasmacomponents3: make Label follow system font changes

Labels in Plasma kept the font they were created with, because Plasma
windows don't propagate font changes to existing items and the Plasma
theme never refreshed its fonts. Refresh them and bind Label to them.

BUG: 480004

media.caption: Master: right after changing General font 10 -> 14 pt, the existing Konsole task label stays small
With the fix: the Konsole task label grows to 14 pt immediately
Master: Dolphin opened afterwards gets 14 pt while Konsole keeps the old size
With the fix: both task labels use the same new size

review.text: Fixes the real cause in libplasma: the Kirigami Plasma theme now refreshes its fonts on ApplicationFontChange through the single style plugin instance, and PlasmaComponents Label binds to Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont like qqc2-desktop-style does. Small, shared startup/live path, no bookkeeping; verification covers live grow/shrink and that bold sub-property overrides survive. Other controls still keep the old font until restart, which is a fair, documented follow-up.
